intro.title: Al-Quds, 1328 AH · 1910
intro.1: You live in Al-Quds with your grandfather, Jiddo Ibrahim, a map-maker. In his workshop stands a rare thing for these days: a motorcar, which he has lovingly restored.
intro.2: Hidden under its seat you found a torn travel journal, the Rihla, written by a traveller of your own family more than five hundred years ago. Its pages are scattered along the old roads.
intro.3: “A road connects hearts before it connects cities,” says Jiddo. “Let us go and find the pages. The first, they say, is kept at a khan on the road down to Ariha.”
